hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.
hero.supportingLine: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: Feature 1
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description: Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs. The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: Additional Feature
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description: Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together. Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)

referenceMap.heroPattern: Single-screen split hero with brand/logo lockup, large headline, short supporting paragraph, and a concise bullet-value list beneath; visually sales-oriented and optimized for quick scan rather than narrative storytelling.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Hero first, then a high-contrast lead capture/form block; content is vertically stacked with clear section separation and minimal mid-page complexity, favoring progressive disclosure through short blocks rather than dense one-page exposition.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Simple utility-first cards with strong container boundaries, minimal decoration, and form-centric emphasis; if used for content blocks, the pattern favors straightforward rectangular panels over decorative glass or elevated cards.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: One primary action in the hero, then a secondary conversion step in the adjacent form area; CTA strategy is lead-gen oriented, using direct imperative labels and repeated conversion prompts rather than many competing buttons.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No pricing section detected; reusable pattern should leave pricing optional and not assume comparison tables, badges, or tier grids.
referenceMap.footerMode: Not visible in the provided reference; assume a standard utility footer only if needed, with low prominence and no heavy conversion role.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Brand/logo media in the hero with little to no product imagery; media treatment is minimal and supporting, not dominant, suggesting a text-led layout with optional decorative or proof visual only.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Feature sections should be compact, benefit-led blocks with a headline, short description, and 4-5 supporting feature bullets; the structure supports sequential modules for each product, each with a clear label and optional CTA.
referenceMap.formPattern: Dedicated lead form panel placed immediately after the hero, visually separated as a conversion surface; uses stacked fields, hidden metadata inputs, and a single submission path, indicating a high-intent capture pattern.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, low-motion presentation; no evidence of motion-led storytelling, so interactions should remain restrained and conversion-focused.
designNotes: Prioritize fast comprehension over visual complexity.
Keep hero copy brief and benefit-oriented.
Use a strong visual hierarchy with one primary CTA per screen.
Separate product storytelling from lead capture.
Favor rigid layout structure and utility spacing over decorative treatments.

personality.buyer: Creative directors, video producers, art directors, content teams, and enterprise buyers seeking high-quality AI image/video generation infrastructure
personality.emotion: Awe, precision, creative control, and enterprise confidence
personality.reasoning: This product sits at the intersection of creative production and advanced AI infrastructure, so the visual language should feel cinematic but controlled. Seedream 4.5 needs a precision-led studio feel for image fidelity, typography, and composition, while Seedance 1.5 Pro should shift into a more immersive motion-driven mood. The overall page should avoid generic SaaS sameness and instead use a premium, editorial, and slightly futuristic system with strong section contrast to reflect the leap from images to audio-visual generation.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The hero headline is moderately long, so 56px keeps it powerful without crowding the split layout or breaking into awkward lines.

colours.colourReason: Deep charcoal establishes premium creative authority and lets the orange brand accent feel energetic, modern, and unmistakably Techjockey. Orange also suits the generative/creative action states, while the light body background keeps dense model information readable.
